mapper.sql: product_id, product_name, category, spec, unit, unit_price, status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY product_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_id, product_name, category, spec, unit, unit_price, status) VALUES (#{productId}, #{productName}, #{category}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{unitPrice}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET product_name = #{productName}, category = #{category}, spec = #{spec}, unit = #{unit}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, status = #{status} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
